title: The Stone Rider
rumor: The Stone Rider. A weathered statue of an armored rider stands upon an isolated hill, though no one remembers erecting it. The rider's face has been worn smooth, and its stone horse points toward the distant mountains. Travelers insist that the statue occasionally turns during the night, and that following its gaze has led prospectors to strange discoveries.
first_lead: A herding route through the northern grasslands passes close enough to see the statue from a distance.
